limitations: Reused research was not re-dated or counted as newly completed. Country/approval evidence remains incomplete for 22 artists.

Existing channel runner filters all selected artist IDs, not task names; it also refreshed the already verified THE ORAL CIGARETTES profile whose selected task was approval only. This is reported as one existing refresh and is not marked as a completed channel task in the queue. No artist outside the frozen 40 was touched.

The supplemental Deep Purple official article was genuinely opened during this run; its submitted checkedAt was estimated from processing time rather than a direct fetch timestamp. The existing research timestamp/validity was preserved.
